name: Attio
label: Attio — CRM records, lists, tasks (REST v2)
description: Official Attio REST API v2 (OpenAPI 2.0.0) at https://api.attio.com. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Bearer workspace token (single-workspace API key). Prefer OAuth for multi-workspace apps — engine auth is Bearer only. person.upsert / company.upsert are PUT upsert-by-matching-attribute. Customer owns the Attio workspace. api_key is never logged. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (trigger.listen) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Set operation to override config.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT catalog verb. trigger.listen (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port).

schema.label: object
schema.description: Object slug or id for record.*, attribute.*, selectOption.create. EXACT common: people | companies | deals, or a custom slug. Example: people.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Attio `data` envelope escape hatch. Purpose fields merge into data / data.values via bodyMap and win on conflict. Custom attributes stay in values or here. Example: {"values":{"job_title":["Engineer"]}}.

schema.label: values
schema.description: Record attribute map for record.create/update. Nested as data.values. Keys are attribute slugs. On person/company upsert use email/name/domains (or the data escape hatch) — values is not sent on those ops. Example: {"email_addresses":["ada@example.com"]}.

schema.label: email
schema.description: Person email on person.upsert. Nested as data.values.email_addresses[0] (Attio accepts a string). Example: ada@example.com.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Person/company name (data.values.name) on person.upsert / company.upsert, or list name (data.name) on list.create. Example: Ada Lovelace.

schema.label: domains
schema.description: Company domains on company.upsert. Nested as data.values.domains. Example: ["example.com"].

schema.label: parent_object
schema.description: List parent object slug on list.create and list.entry.create/update. Nested as data.parent_object. EXACT common: people | companies | deals. Example: people.

schema.label: api_slug
schema.description: API slug on list.create or attribute.create. Nested as data.api_slug. Example: hot_leads.

schema.label: parent_record_id
schema.description: Parent record UUID on list.entry.create/update. Nested as data.parent_record_id. Example: 0f8c3e2a-….

schema.label: entry_values
schema.description: List-entry attribute values on list.entry.create/update. Nested as data.entry_values. Example: {"stage":["Qualified"]}.

schema.label: title
schema.description: Attribute or select-option title on attribute.create / selectOption.create. Nested as data.title. Example: Industry.

schema.label: type
schema.description: Attribute type on attribute.create. Nested as data.type. EXACT common: text | number | date | timestamp | checkbox | email-address | domain | select. Example: text.

schema.label: content
schema.description: Task text on task.create/update (max 2000). Nested as data.content. Example: Follow up Monday.

schema.label: format
schema.description: Task content format on task.create/update. EXACT: plaintext | markdown. Nested as data.format. Example: plaintext.

schema.label: deadline_at
schema.description: Task deadline ISO-8601 on task.create/update. Nested as data.deadline_at. Example: 2026-12-01T17:00:00.000Z.

schema.label: is_completed
schema.description: Task completed flag on task.create/update. Nested as data.is_completed. Example: false.

schema.label: assignees
schema.description: Task actor array on task.create/update. Nested as data.assignees. Example: [{"referenced_actor_type":"workspace-member","referenced_actor_id":"…"}].

schema.label: record_id
schema.description: Record UUID for record.get/update/delete. Example: 0f8c3e2a-….

schema.label: filter
schema.description: Attio filter object for record.search and list.entry.search. Example: {"email_addresses":{"email_address":{"eq":"ada@example.com"}}}.

schema.label: sorts
schema.description: Sort array for record.search / list.entry.search. Example: [{"attribute":"created_at","direction":"desc"}].

schema.label: limit
schema.description: Page size for record.search / list.entry.search. Positive integer, Attio caps apply. Example: 50.

schema.label: offset
schema.description: Offset for record.search / list.entry.search. Example: 0.

schema.label: matching_attribute
schema.description: Unique attribute slug used as the upsert match query on person.upsert / company.upsert. EXACT common: email_addresses | domains. Example: email_addresses.

schema.label: list
schema.description: List id or slug for list.entry.* . Example: hot_leads.

schema.label: entry_id
schema.description: List entry UUID for list.entry.update/delete. Example: 0f8c3e2a-….

schema.label: attribute_id
schema.description: Attribute id or slug for attribute.archive and selectOption.create. Example: industry.

schema.label: task_id
schema.description: Task UUID for task.update. Allowed body fields: deadline_at, is_completed, linked_records, assignees, content, format.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream status code.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON body. Minimize retained PII.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: record.create | record.get | record.update | record.search | record.delete | person.upsert | company.upsert | list.create | list.entry.create | list.entry.update | list.entry.delete | list.entry.search | attribute.create | attribute.archive | selectOption.create | task.create | task.update | trigger.listen. Selecting trigger.listen (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: Workspace API token (developer settings) or OAuth access token. Authorization: Bearer. Admin API keys are 64 characters — partial copy causes HTTP 401. Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
